result.controls: The sham carries no intended semantic mapping and is independent of target labels.
result.interpretation: This bounded control establishes feature-shape matching only; it does not estimate a model effect until paired training is run.
result.methods: Replaced axiological feature values with seeded sham tokens while preserving per-record feature counts and dataset dimensions.
result.next_action: Run a matched C1-versus-sham model comparison with the same optimizer and seed schedule.
result.research_question: Are intended semantic improvements distinguishable from dimensionality- and sparsity-matched sham features?
